prompt: Complete IdGenerator so every new instance takes the next number from ONE static counter shared across all instances -- "user-1", "user-2", then "order-3" -- with a static resetCounter for tests.
explanation: A static field belongs to the class, not to any one object: there is exactly one counter in memory no matter how many IdGenerator instances exist, which is why the third instance gets 3 even with a different prefix. Each instance copies the current number into its own instance field id, so later increments (or a reset) never change ids that were already handed out. resetCounter is static because it operates purely on class-level state.
hints: Increment the static counter inside the constructor before building the id string.
Store prefix + "-" + counter in the instance field id; the instance keeps that snapshot forever.
resetCounter just assigns 0 to the static field -- it needs no instance, which is why it is static.
